author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/30_Confined Space Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Confined Space Safety Quiz（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过
points.K2: 通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
points.K5: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
points.K8: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
points.S1: 气体报警器响了怎么办
points.S3: 上岗前后做职业健康检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在打开的检修口旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an open maintenance hatch, keeping a safe distance, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的测验：有限空间！

shots.scene: 实验楼地下水池的检修口被打开
shots.prompt_en: The maintenance hatch of an underground water tank beside a laboratory building is open. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼的地下水池要清洗检修。

shots.scene: 阿杰探头想往下看，老李伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans toward the hatch; the facility engineer stretches out an arm to stop him.
shots.narration: 阿杰想探头看看，被老李拦住。

shots.scene: 老李递给他一张空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands him a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 老李说：先答完这几道题。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 空白测验框：十个进度格和计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz panel with ten progress segments and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题十分钟，答对八题才过。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 结果页红绿两色标记
shots.prompt_en: A blank result panel with some answers marked red and some marked green. No people.
shots.narration: 交卷后看对错，弄懂再重做。

shots.section_title: 通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
shots.scene: 一排图标：风机、防护服、梯子、检测仪、救援三脚架
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a ventilation fan, a protective suit, a ladder, a gas detector and a rescue tripod. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间安全，记住这几件事。
overlay: 通风、防护、进出、检测、救援

shots.section_title: 通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
shots.scene: 王老师翻开审批单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank approval form.
shots.narration: 先审批、先通风、再检测、后作业。

shots.scene: 老李和同事在空地上演练用三脚架救人
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the security officer practice a rescue drill with a tripod and harness on open ground.
shots.narration: 第一题：救援演练什么时候做？

shots.scene: 一年一次、只在新人来时的日历图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a single circled date and a new-worker icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 要定期练，不是一年一次应付。

shots.scene: 日历上多次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with several regular check marks across the months. No people.
shots.narration: 练熟了，出事时才不慌乱。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上几种气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank gas detector screen showing several different gas molecule icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：有毒物质的接触限值？

shots.scene: 统一数字卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A single number card is crossed out with a red X; several different cards stand beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 每种物质限值不同，没有统一数。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家职业卫生标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank occupational health standards book.
shots.narration: 查国家职业卫生标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员守在检修口外，手里拿着对讲机
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands outside the hatch holding a radio, watching the opening closely.
shots.narration: 第三题：监护人做什么？
overlay: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 远处监督和下去帮忙的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person watching from far away and a person climbing in to help. No people.
shots.narration: 不是远远看着，也不是下去帮忙。

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 值班员按下对讲机呼叫，旁边是救援三脚架
shots.prompt_en: The security officer presses the radio button and points to a rescue tripod beside the hatch.
shots.narration: 全程盯住，一有异常马上呼救。

shots.scene: 老李、王老师、值班员三人在审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, the safety administrator and the security officer each sign a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 第四题：进入审批谁参与？

shots.scene: 只有一个工人签字的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single worker signing alone is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 负责人、安全员、监护人都要到位。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：人群、喇叭、氧气向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards: a crowd, a loudspeaker and an oxygen symbol with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：主要风险是什么？

shots.scene: 氧气卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The oxygen card is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧，人可能几口气就倒下。

shots.scene: 检修口外风机向里送风
shots.prompt_en: A ventilation fan blows fresh air down into the hatch through a duct. No people.
shots.narration: 所以进入前必须充分通风。

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 检测仪挂在老李胸前，屏幕亮着
shots.prompt_en: A portable gas detector clipped to the chest of the facility engineer, its blank screen glowing.
shots.narration: 第六题：为什么要连续监测？
overlay: 连续监测，发现有毒气体

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 温度计和风扇图标打叉，毒气图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and a fan icon are crossed out; a toxic gas icon is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 为了及时发现有毒气体。

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 检测仪报警灯闪，老李往外撤
shots.prompt_en: The gas detector flashes a warning light and the facility engineer climbs out quickly.
shots.narration: 空气随时会变，一报警就撤。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 阿杰的答题卡全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up an answer card full of green checks.
shots.narration: 阿杰全答对，也明白了不能探头。

shots.section_title: 气体报警器响了怎么办
shots.scene: 实验室墙上的固定式气体报警器闪红灯
shots.prompt_en: A fixed gas alarm unit on a laboratory wall flashes red. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室也有气体报警器。
overlay: 气体报警器响了怎么办

shots.section_title: 气体报警器响了怎么办
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰离开实验室，关上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student out of the lab and closes the door.
shots.narration: 报警一响，立刻离开，关门。

shots.section_title: 气体报警器响了怎么办
shots.scene: 小研在门外给老周和保卫处打电话
shots.prompt_en: Outside the door, the female graduate student calls on her phone.
shots.narration: 通知负责人和保卫处，等专业处理。

shots.section_title: 气体报警器响了怎么办
shots.scene: 冲进去查看的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing back into a room is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要自己回去查看。

shots.scene: 老李戴着全面罩呼吸器，额头冒汗
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a full face respirator and sweats on his forehead.
shots.narration: 戴呼吸器干活，比平时累得多。

shots.scene: 王老师帮他调整面罩贴合
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator helps him check the fit of the face mask.
shots.narration: 按国家标准选型，先试戴、调贴合。

shots.scene: 老李摘下面罩在通风处休息
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes off the mask and rests in fresh air outside.
shots.narration: 控制佩戴时间，轮换休息。

shots.section_title: 上岗前后做职业健康检查
shots.scene: 老李在医务室做体检
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sits for a health check with a doctor in a clinic.
shots.narration: 有限空间作业人员要做健康检查。
overlay: 上岗前后做职业健康检查

shots.section_title: 上岗前后做职业健康检查
shots.scene: 三个时间点图标：上岗前、在岗期间、离岗时
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with three markers: before starting the job, during the job and when leaving the job. No people.
shots.narration: 上岗前、在岗期间、离岗时都要查。

shots.section_title: 上岗前后做职业健康检查
shots.scene: 心脏和肺的图标旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and lung icons with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 身体不适合的，不安排这类作业。

shots.scene: 流程图：审批、通风、检测、监护、救援
shots.prompt_en: A flow chart of five boxes joined by arrows with icons: a form, a fan, a detector, a person with a radio and a tripod. No people.
shots.narration: 审批、通风、检测、监护、能救援。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在围挡外，向检修口竖起警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands outside a barrier and props up a confined space danger sign by the hatch.
shots.narration: 不是作业人员，不靠近不探头。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye, standing safely away from the hatch.
shots.narration: 有限空间不乱进，平安回家！
